rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday locative phrase for being or going below the ground.

example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 ji4 gaa1 hai2 dei6 dai2 haang4 gan2

rows.note: Use 地底 as the all-purpose choice for the literal below-ground sense, especially in compounds such as 地底隧道.

example.english: This underground tunnel will be finished soon.
example.traditional: 呢條地底隧道就快起好喇。
example.jyutping: ne1 tiu4 dei6 dai2 seoi6 dou6 zau6 faai3 hei2 hou2 laa3

rows.note: Use this when someone does something secretly or without others noticing.

example.english: They secretly moved the goods underground.
example.traditional: 佢哋偷偷咁將啲貨搬咗落地底。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 tau1 tau1 gam3 zoeng1 di1 fo3 bun1 zo2 lok6 dei6 dai2

rows.note: Use 地下 for clandestine organizations and for non-mainstream arts or subcultures, as in 地下組織 and 地下音樂.

example.english: The police are investigating an underground organization.
example.traditional: 警方追查緊一個地下組織。
example.jyutping: ging2 fong1 zeoi1 caa4 gan2 jat1 go3 dei6 haa6 zou2 zik1

rows.note: Use 秘密 when the emphasis is simply on something being secret or hidden, without the subcultural sense carried by 地下.

example.english: They held an underground meeting in secret because they did not want anyone to know.
example.traditional: 佢哋秘密咁開會，唔想畀人知道。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 bei3 mat6 gam3 hoi1 wui2 m4 soeng2 bei2 jan4 zi1 dou3
